author: yungmuck
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: I was banned in game and appealed about 3-4 months ago and didn't rly get a full reply and never had time to make the video for my complete appeal but finally got around to making it and also I'm making the appeal here because the new appeal system wasn't working for me

Staff Member: MODSpookeh after he retired

Guilty? (Yes or No): Some say I was some say I wasn't and the evidence video against me was convincing but I can assure you I'm clean as I love this server dearly but heres my evidence https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Nnnn-S32XM&feature=youtu.be

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I think I should be unbanned because I was not auto clicking just trying out a new mouse and new bridging styles since I was just learning to jitter click.

Any additional comments?: Again sorry it took so long but I lost my computer a few days after getting banned but since I got it back I'm able to make my full appeal with evidence. If I'm still not unbanned hey ill wait it out a few more months and re appeal since I would love to come back onto the server and play with the community again if they accept me. Thanks! In regards, Muckeh, Also if you have any questions about the video or appeal my skype is muckyman123 msg me here or there either is fine!

replies.author: joelous
replies.body:
The evidence you provided Muckyy isn't consistent with the evidence that we were given. Besides, evidence recorded external to Avicus is highly frowned upon - especially with modifications such as autoclicker. It seems like you struggle to complete the staircases, but you easily make it in our video. 

Therefore you will need to firstly be patient, as I can see you are not, and please appeal in a couple months time.

Happy holidays!
